mapper.sql: id, create_date, update_date, create_by, update_by, is_deleted, tenant_id, work_day, start_work, end_work, live_room_id, remark, schedule_duration, rest_duration
mapper.insert:
insert into work_schedule (id, create_date, update_date, create_by, update_by, is_deleted, tenant_id, work_day, start_work, end_work, live_room_id, remark, schedule_duration, rest_duration) values
(#{item.id,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{item.createDate,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{item.updateDate,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{item.createBy,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{item.updateBy,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{item.isDeleted,jdbcType=BOOLEAN}, #{item.tenantId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{item.workDay,jdbcType=DATE}, #{item.startWork,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{item.endWork,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{item.liveRoomId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{item.remark,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.scheduleDuration,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{item.restDuration,jdbcType=INTEGER} )
mapper.select: select id, live_room_id, work_day, start_work, end_work, schedule_duration, rest_duration, remark from work_schedule where live_room_id = #{roomId} and work_day >= #{startDay} and work_day <= #{endDay} and is_deleted = 0

select id, live_room_id, work_day, start_work, end_work, schedule_duration, rest_duration, remark from work_schedule where is_deleted = 0
and (
(live_room_id = #{q.roomId} and work_day >= #{q.startDay} and work_day <= #{q.endDay})
)
and 1 = 0
